exact_owner_facing_decision: Approve E33 to build the Agent Action Black Box demo packet, or choose a backup MVP if the black-box framing feels too abstract for first validation.
first_demo_artifact: Agent Action Black Box demo packet for the E31 paid readiness-review sample action
first_monetization_route: fixed-fee Agent Action Legitimacy Audit / black-box review
first_validation_route: owner-approved low-risk demo review with a friendly AI operator/consultancy or publication walkthrough only after approval
kill_criteria: Owner cannot explain the MVP in one sentence after reviewing packet.
Friendly reviewers see it as generic observability or generic consulting.
The demo cannot show evidence boundary, preflight decision, receipt, and learning writeback in one flow.

rejected_candidates.reason: Prerequisite-only and not market-shocking without a buyer-visible trust demo.
Could explain the idea but would not demonstrate unique action-trust capability.
Commercially useful but too narrow; does not expose the deeper agent-action void.

success_criteria: Owner approves one-sentence positioning and first demo shape.
Demo packet shows intent-to-action-to-evidence-to-learning chain without external effects.
At least one future low-risk reviewer understands the urgency without a long philosophical explanation.
why_selected: It turns the abstract Y* philosophy into a concrete artifact buyers can understand.
It uses existing Y* wheels: CEO KG, evidence binding, provider containment, receipts, branch reasoning, and CZL closure.
It avoids fake validation because it can demo locally with public evidence and no-send receipts.
It is closer to revenue than broad platform productization while preserving product, governance, and partner branches.
